method: Web search + image search; primary museum/institution catalogue text; actual linked photographs/diagram inspected in temporary browser tab, closed afterwards.

entries.title: Copy of Thimonnier's chain-stitch sewing machine, 1830
entries.adopted: Wooden open frame, projecting sewing work-table, barbed needle above fabric, reel below, integrated flywheel.
entries.limits: Museum copy, not asserted original 1830 specimen; symbolic simplification. Internal key advanced_spinning actually refers to sewing mechanization in current localization. No gameplay/date changes.

entries.title: Oliver Evans system at George Washington's Mount Vernon
entries.adopted: Mechanically transported grain between elevator, hopper and stones; connected processes rather than a windmill silhouette.
entries.limits: Diagram of the institution's historic mill; present machinery reconstructed in 2006. Icon is a compact conceptual assembly, not an exact scale reconstruction of its full multi-floor system.

entries.title: Robert's Paper-Making Machine, 1798
entries.adopted: Wooden frame, vat, moving wire cloth, rollers and integral crank.
entries.limits: Museum scale model of the 1798 design, not an original operating machine. Continuous white paper web deliberately accentuated for small-size reading; not an exact replica.
